findings.evidence: r-7 D8.2 and the sc-agent-http sample (lines 595, 802-820) make `trace: SendTrace` a required parameter of send_with_busy_retry, send_and_parse and HttpClient::send_and_parse. The Option builder is gone. The backends pass `req.send_trace().clone()` (r-7 lines 120, 125, 820). The r-7 test table says the compiler enforces it at every caller (line 842). r-6 lines 197-200 build on the required parameter. No new gate was added.

ProjectLabel moved into r-7. It is core, in ids.rs (r-7 line 99). RowContext.project is now `Option<ProjectLabel>` (line 770), validated by ProjectLabel::new, so try_from_fields uses the same validator (D8.4, line 605). r-6 line 243 consumes r-7's ProjectLabel, and LogContext in r-6 takes Option<ProjectLabel>. There is one owner of project validity.

r-7 line 553 says ModelFamily is the only family schema_for consumes and is never derived from BackendFamily (the catalog's how-we-call family). Line 315 puts the rule in the architecture doc amendment. The fix is the one sentence I asked for, with no gate.

notes: All three carry-forward ids are closed. I found no new Blocking issue and no problem introduced by the fix commits. I did not check the boundary-validator report. I reviewed the manifests and sources named in the plan documents.
r-6 line 342 still shows `with_sent_body` recording into `req.send_trace()`, which matches the required-parameter design. No conflict.
